title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Waste Management - MobileCollectionPoint
description: A temporary, mobile waste collection point, e.g. a scheduled collection van visiting a street on a set day/time (edintwaste:MobileCollectionPoint, subclass of edintwaste:CollectionPoint, edintwaste:WasteFacility, edint-infraestructura's Facility). Bare CollectionPoint/WasteFacility are not materialized as their own entities, matching this candidate family's precedent for abstract bases.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MobileCollectionPoint'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/address'. The mailing address (reusing esdir:DireccionPostal). Inherited from WasteFacility.

belongsTo.description: Relationship. Territorial unit(s) (Barrio, Distrito or Municipio) this facility belongs to (edintwaste:belongsTo). Modeled as an array since the source's own real example data shows a WasteContainer belonging to both a Barrio and a Distrito simultaneously. Inherited from WasteFacility.

contactPoint.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/ContactPoint'. Contact point for this facility.

acceptsWasteType.description: Property. Waste type(s) accepted at this point, from the WasteType controlled vocabulary (edintwaste:acceptsWasteType). Inherited from CollectionPoint.

isPubliclyOwned.description: Property. Whether the point is publicly owned (edintwaste:isPubliclyOwned). Inherited from CollectionPoint.

map.description: Property. A map/directions link for this mobile collection point (edintwaste:map).

admissibleWasteURL.description: Property. Link to information on admissible waste for this mobile collection point (edintwaste:admissibleWasteURL).
